details.description: GLM-4.7 is Z.ai's (formerly Zhipu AI) open-weight Mixture-of-Experts language model, released December 22, 2025 with 355 billion total parameters and 32 billion active per token, per Z.ai's GitHub model repository. It targets agentic software-engineering workflows -- multi-file coding, end-to-end task execution, and stable multi-step tool use -- and supports interleaved and preserved thinking that carries reasoning context across turns, per Z.ai's documentation. It is a text-only model with a 200K-token context window; as of September 2026, Z.ai's newer GLM-5 series (through GLM-5.3) has become the flagship, though GLM-4.7 remains listed as an active, available model.
advantages: Scores 73.8% on SWE-bench Verified, a 5.8-point improvement over GLM-4.6, per Z.ai's documentation.
Scores 84.9 on LiveCodeBench V6, which Z.ai says surpasses Claude Sonnet 4.5 on that benchmark.
Supports interleaved thinking, thinking that persists across conversation turns, and per-turn thinking controls, per Z.ai's documentation.
355 billion total parameters with 32 billion active per token in a Mixture-of-Experts architecture, per Z.ai's GitHub model repository.
disadvantages: Superseded as Z.ai's flagship chat model by the GLM-5 series (through GLM-5.3, released August 2026), per Z.ai's release-notes page, though GLM-4.7 remains an active, available model.
Text-only model; does not accept image or other non-text input, per Z.ai's API documentation.
use_cases: Multi-file software engineering and end-to-end coding task completion
Agentic workflows with multi-step tool use and orchestration

sources.title: New Released - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT

notes: Catalog's max_output_tokens (4000) is far below Z.ai's own stated 128K max output for GLM-4.7's native API (docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-4.7); likely a Bedrock-specific output cap, kept the catalog's value per instructions. Catalog's max_input_tokens (203000) is close to Z.ai's stated 200K context window, not flagged as a conflict. Sources disagreed on GLM-4.7's tau-squared-Bench score (84.7 per docs.z.ai's guide vs 87.4 on its Hugging Face card), so that benchmark was left out of evaluations. As of September 2026, Z.ai's GLM-5 series (through GLM-5.3, released August 18, 2026) is the current flagship chat model, with GLM-4.7 an older but still actively offered generation, per docs.z.ai's pricing and release-notes pages. No explicit language list found on maker pages beyond 'en'/'zh' metadata tags, so languages is left empty.
